caption: The drawing is a colored plan view of a garden or estate. At the center there is a large, irregularly shaped green area labeled "Lawn." Surrounding the lawn are various paths depicted in light tan, which encircle and divide the property. In the top left corner, there are rectangular plots labeled for crops or garden beds, with some labeled as "Orchard," "Fruit Garden," and different vegetable areas. To the left of the lawn there is a cluster of buildings, including a detailed house with adjoining garden features and a barn near the top. Scattered around the property are various types of trees and shrubs represented as circles of different sizes shaded in greens, browns, and purples, some labeled with their species or use. Along the right and lower edges, there are hedgerows or tree lines. The bottom edge of the drawing is decorated with a border of detailed, colored illustrations of pansies and other flowers, with blossoms in shades of purple, yellow, pink, and red, alongside green leaves. The title "Estate of Charles Stoughton" and the scale are written in cursive near the bottom center. The overall color palette includes greens for the grass and trees, browns for the paths and structures, and multiple colors for the decorative flowers.
title: Stoughton Estate
